text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Cheval Grand takes the lead!
Cheval Grand is in front!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Pushing through two hills with every ounce of strength—
Cheval Grand crosses the finish line in first place!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (――WOOOOAAAAAHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —...*gasp*... *wheeze*... hah... haah...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
D... did I win? Really...?
...*cough*, *wheeze*, haah, haah...
No waaaay!! I-I lost~!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —Cheval-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Hyek! Ah... Wh-Wh-Wh-What is it?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You know, I'm really frustrated!
Losing is super, super frustrating!
But—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: That felt so, so good!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I didn't think about anything bad and just ran with a clear head! It feels like I gave it eveeery single bit of my strength!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Back when I was sulking and bitter, it hurt so much...
I kept wondering if there was even any point in me running.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Still, I gave it my absolute all today!
And since I still lost, Cheval-chan, you really are amazing!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing! Congratulations!
But I definitely won't lose next time!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait... Uh, e-even if you declare war so refreshingly,
I-I-I...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand, that was amazing!!
Way to go, Kita-chan, nice job!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Good luck next time too, Kita-chaaan!!
Kita Boss!! We're counting on ya!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, thank you to everyone, too!
Even though I lost today...――

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
From here on, I'll get even stronger, stronger still!!
And I'll deliver tons and tons of races
that will bring a smile to everyone's faces!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Haha, look at that sparkling smile...
Kitasan Black really is incredible after all.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Bright... positive...
Even if she breaks, she gets right back up and starts running.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way home from giving her all at the Kikuka Sho,
Cheval Grand suddenly spoke up.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...T-T-T-Trainer-than!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Auugh. I'm sorry, right at the important part...
Umm...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you so much for today.
I'm so glad I got to run in the Kikuka Sho...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I feel like this is the first time
I've truly been able to look at Kita-san properly!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: And so, um... I, um...
choice_data_list: It's okay to take it slow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Struggling as she usually did to talk about herself, she did her best to find the words. It seemed she had something very important to say.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While strolling along leisurely, I listen to Cheval Grand's words.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The story began back around the time of her debut.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: About myself, who hadn't stood out compared to my classmates, and Kitasan Black, who had similarly gone unnoticed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And yet, Kitasan Black was believing in herself and putting in positive effort.
She secretly felt a sense of inferiority at the contrast between them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the Japan Derby, I learned that even she
harboring feelings of inferiority toward someone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And today... Kitasan Black turned even her feelings
of inferiority into strength, directly receiving the cheers
of the audience—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"When I was thinking, 'Everyone's so much better than me anyway...'
I was actually blinded to what was right in front of me—"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Kita-san's true strength...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
When you look up to someone, you chase after them earnestly.
When you feel the gap between you, you get genuinely down about it.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I won't run away from feeling inferior to my peers.
I'll train with all my might... and overcome my weak self—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
In the end, he's totally different from me...
But... that's precisely why—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This must be where the real talk begins.
Cheval Grand takes several deep breaths.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer...!
I... I'm about to—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I'm... going to say something very... p-presumptuous!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Y-You can laugh at me if you want...
Or think I'm hopeless... but please, just hear me out...!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I-I couldn't help thinking it... I-I... I want to, t-too—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ……I, ……wanna……!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I want to properly become stronger... too.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Just like how Kita-san proved
her own strength today...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Looking straight ahead no matter what—
I don't have that kind of strength...
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I want to believe that I'm strong too...,
that I have a strength all my own.
That's why—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My heart warms at Cheval Grand's confession.
I wonder how many hurdles she had to overcome
before finally being able to put these feelings into words.
choice_data_list: Then there's only one thing to do.
Then there's only one thing to do!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Instead of deciding to run at the last minute like this time,
next time the goal from the start will be to compete against Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'll challenge Kitasan Black as a true rival right from the start,
with a burning desire to win!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I want to say 'someone like me...'
I want to run away, saying it's impossible for me... but—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I want to run.
—With Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Cheval Grand, who had previously only ever looked at her own weaknesses, is looking outward for the very first time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of her growth,
this will surely be a worthwhile race.
Or so I thought to myself—
